import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file
  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)
  cookie-get <name>           get a specific cookie by name
  cookie-set <name> <value>   set a cookie with optional flags
  cookie-delete <name>        delete a specific cookie
  cookie-clear                clear all cookies
  localstorage-list           list all localstorage key-value pairs
  localstorage-get <key>      get a localstorage item by key
  localstorage-set <key> <value> set a localstorage item

function computeStats(){
 const car=CARS[S.carId], armor=ARMOR[S.armorId], weapon=WEAPONS[S.weaponId];
 const pl=(id)=>S.parts[id]||0;
 return {
  maxHealth: 100 + armor.health + pl('fuel')*12,
  maxArmor: armor.armor + pl('plating')*16,
  speed: car.stats.speed*(1+pl('engine')*0.07),
  handling: car.stats.handling*(1+pl('tires')*0.07),
  damageMult: (1+pl('engine')*0.02+pl('roof')*0.06),
  fireRate: 1+pl('targeting')*0.05,
  rangeMult: 1+pl('targeting')*0.05,
  scrapMult: 1+pl('scavenger')*0.08,
  ram: 30*car.stats.ram*(1+pl('ram')*0.26),
  nitroCd: Math.max(4, 9-pl('nitro')*1.2),
  collisionMult: Math.max(0.5, 1-pl('suspension')*0.07),
  heal: 0.25+pl('recovery')*0.05,
  slowAura: 0.08*pl('horn'),
  damageTaken: 1/car.stats.armor,
  baseMax: 120+S.baseLevels.hull*45,
  slots: 3+S.baseLevels.hardpoint,
  turretDmg: 1+S.baseLevels.ammo*0.12,
  turretRange: 1+S.baseLevels.optics*0.12,
  repair: S.baseLevels.repair*0.10,
  barricade: S.baseLevels.barricade*0.25,
 };
}
```

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D mobile game titled **THE LONG ROAD** matching: long road, many stops, cool cars, many car parts, cool weapons, medium-weak zombies, armor, base, tower defense.

## Requirements
- Build now; do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them.
- 2D, mobile-first, playable end-to-end.
- Include many stops, cars, parts, weapons, zombies, armor, base, and tower defense.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for self-checks; only read latest; full-size PNG only for fine detail.

## Decisions
- Single static HTML/CSS/JS project using Canvas 2D, no build step or external assets.
- Core loop: auto-scrolling road survival leg → holdout tower defense at each stop → garage upgrades → next leg; 12 stops ending at Haven.
- 5 cars, 6 weapons, 5 armor sets, 12 car parts, 6 turrets, 6 base modules, 12 stop biomes, 4 boss stops.
- Auto-fire while driving; drag to steer; NOS ability.
- Holdout: place owned turrets on hardpoints, drag to aim rig gun, auto-fire turrets, Pulse shockwave ability.
- Scrap economy, persistent garage, localStorage save/resume, retry checkpoint, victory screen.
- Procedural WebAudio sound effects and synthesized title ambience/engine hum.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built complete static game structure: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `js/data.js`, `js/audio.js`, `js/game.js`.
- Implemented title screen with animated sunset road, car, zombie silhouettes, ash, logo, continue/new-run/save-erase/how-to-play.
- Implemented road mode: scrolling road, biome palettes, props, zombies, auto-target weapons, collisions, scrap, health/armor pickups, part caches, NOS, HUD, route progress, pause.
- Implemented holdout mode: build phase, turret placement/recall/auto-place, waves, boss spawns, rig HP, player aim gun, Pulse, turret types/upgrades, wave rewards, stop completion.
- Implemented garage: cars/weapons/armor/parts/base tabs, purchases/equips/upgrades, scrap checks, stats, car preview canvas, next-leg flow.
- Implemented save/continue/reset, game over/retry, victory, pause, mute, visibility auto-pause.
- Playwright flow verified: title → road → stop → turret placement → wave 1 → wave 2 → garage → buy shotgun → base tab → next leg.
- Visual fixes applied: title car repositioned, base moved up, garage preview rotated/scaled, headlight opacity reduced, props seeded immediately, bridge/tunnel ambience, smaller car weapon/stripes, hint moved to top, favicon added, armor health-delta bug fixed, completed-wave continue edge case guarded.
- `node --check js/game.js` passes.

### Active
- Reviewing latest `screenshots/holdout-new.jpg` after base-position and hint changes.
- Need final verification of new holdout layout, garage car preview, desktop responsiveness, title after reload.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/holdout-new.jpg` to confirm rig now fully visible above build panel and hint placement looks correct.
2. Test desktop viewport (e.g. 1280×800) title, road, holdout, garage.
3. Verify no console errors beyond expected favicon (now fixed), no runtime exceptions.
4. Test a full stop clear + garage + next leg after latest changes; verify save/resume and pause.
5. Consider final polish only if needed: car readability, holdout turret size, zombie arm contrast, garage preview.
6. Update README briefly if desired and leave changes uncommitted unless asked.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: full app markup, screens, HUD, build panel, title/garage/modals.
- `styles.css`: complete visual design, responsive layout, HUD, garage, build panel, modals, animations.
- `js/game.js`: all game logic, state, saving, waves, combat, rendering, input, loop.
- `js/data.js`: cars, weapons, armor, parts, turrets, base modules, stops, enemies, bosses, tips.
- `js/audio.js`: procedural WebAudio engine and sound effects.
- `screenshots/`: generated Playwright verification images.
- `start.sh`: starts static server via runtime script; server currently running on `http://localhost:3002` in tmux session `longroad`.
- `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/output/console-2026-11-11T11-12-24-840Z.log`: browser console log; only favicon 404s seen, now addressed.

# THE LONG ROAD

**Drive. Loot. Hold the line.** A 2D, mobile-first road-trip survival game with tower defense at every stop.

You are the last rig rolling toward **Haven**, 388 miles of zombie-infested highway away. Each leg is an auto-scrolling road run: drag to steer, auto-fire at anything in range, ram the weak ones, and scavenge scrap. Every stop turns into a holdout — place turrets on hardpoints, aim the rig gun, and survive the waves. Spend scrap in the garage on cars, weapons, armor, car parts, turrets, and base modules, then take the next leg.

## Features

- **12 stops** across distinct biomes, including **4 boss stops**, ending at Haven.
- **5 cars**, **6 weapons**, **5 armor sets**, and **12 car parts** with upgrade levels.
- **6 turret types** and **6 base modules** for the holdout defense.
- Two interlocking modes: auto-scrolling road survival and hardpoint tower defense.
- Scrap economy, persistent garage, checkpoint retry, pause, mute, and victory/defeat flow.
- Save/resume via `localStorage` (key `the-long-road-save-v1`).
- Procedural WebAudio sound effects and engine ambience — no external assets.
- Single static build: Canvas 2D + HTML/CSS/JS, no bundler or dependencies.

## Play

Open `index.html` through a local web server (ES modules require HTTP):

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8080
# then open http://localhost:8080
```

On desktop, drag with the mouse or use **A/D** or **←/→** to steer; **Space** fires the Pulse/shockwave ability; **Esc/P** pauses. On mobile, drag anywhere on the road to steer, tap hardpoints to place turrets, and drag on the holdout field to aim the rig gun.

## Structure

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.html` | Screens, HUD, build panel, garage, modals |
| `styles.css` | Full visual design and responsive layout |
| `js/data.js` | Cars, weapons, armor, parts, turrets, base modules, stops, enemies |
| `js/audio.js` | Procedural WebAudio engine and sound effects |
| `js/game.js` | Game state, road/holdout logic, combat, waves, saving, rendering, input |

## Assumptions

- Mobile-first portrait layout; desktop centers the play field and keeps the same controls.
- Progression is linear across the 12 stops; a run can be resumed from the last checkpoint.
- All art and audio are procedural so the game runs offline with no asset pipeline.
